title: [narrowed from route-edit-40d87f78] In repos/development-vessel/src/resolvers/substrate-gap.ts, the function gapFromFlat
description:
[narrowed from route-edit-40d87f78] In repos/development-vessel/src/resolvers/substrate-gap.ts, the function gapFromFlatPointer builds its returned gap object from only these fields: id, category, source, status, detected_at, summary, and an optional route. It silently discards classification_metadata, so any gap written through the flat-pointer path loses its measurement predicate (edit_site, expected_literal, hardcoded_url) and classifyFalsifier then stamps falsifier "none" because it receives an empty object.

Change: carry classification_metadata through in that returned object literal, exactly as the optional route field is already carried, when the incoming flat pointer supplies it as an object.

The anchor is this verbatim line inside gapFromFlatPointer:

    ...(str("route") ? { route: str("route") } : {}),

Add one sibling spread immediately after that line so the returned object also includes classification_metadata when the pointer carries an object under that key. Do not change any other function, and do not change the merge semantics at the update site.

WHY PREVIOUS ATTEMPTS ON THIS GAP FAILED (most recent last):
- semantic_reject: The patch adds duplicate `classification_metadata` spreads and one of the added spreads directly overwrites the previously existing, correct spread, which doesn't adhere to the instructions to add a s
- semantic_reject: The patch incorrectly adds duplicate spreads for classification_metadata and does not follow the required syntax for optional fields, failing to genuinely fix the gap.
- wrong_location: The patch adds duplicate classification_metadata spreads and incorrectly duplicates the optional field pattern, violating the required single sibling spread and causing type errors, so it does not gen

Do not repeat these failures. Address the specific cause named above.
